info.text:
Your four-leg parlay should pay 15 to 1. It pays about 12.
$10 on four 50/50 legs at -110 returns $132.83 when it wins. Fair odds would return $160.
On average that ticket gets back about $8.30: a 17% cut, versus about 4.5% on a single bet.
In Colorado (July 2025 to July 2026), sportsbooks kept 15.51% of parlay money vs 6.46% of other bets.
Sources: American Gaming Association, Colorado Division of Gaming.
